answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 7195 Country: OM Title: I was ill having flu cold fever today.i did nt go for jammat in fajr cause i thought the disease wil increase as it was cold in the morning. is it right? Question: I was ill having flu cold fever today.i did nt go for jammat in fajr cause i thought the disease wil increase as it was cold in the morning. is it right? Answer ID: 7195 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1420/1336=D/1429) If you fear that your disease would definitely increase, then it was a legal reason not to go to the mosque and attend jamat , but because of this it is impermissible to miss the salah from its time: وعد صاحب نور الإيضاح من اعذار المبحية لترك الجماعة حيث قال وسقام ، وقال بعده واذا انقطع عن الجماعة لعذر من اعذارها المبحية للتخلف وكانت نيته حضورھا لو لا العذرالحاصل يحصل ثوابها (حاشيه طحاوى: 299) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
